You stand on the ice of the Lynsk at midnight, alone, with the whole of the north in front of you. The rite of the Great Warding is older than the Sisterhood, and it asks for something that cannot be given back. You open your hands and let the cold take it: years of your life, poured into the river, into the frozen ground, into every stanitsa wall from here to the Tzar's palace.
Let the north find Kislev closed to it.

There is a sorcerer in the oblast. The cattle in three villages are dead with their eyes burned out, and the people of a fourth all dream the same dream of a burning tower. The trail runs east toward the forest.
I will hunt him myself.
Send the lord's men after him.

You find him in a village that has burned to the ground, standing in the ashes with fire running over his hands like water. He smiles when he sees you. He has always wanted to know whether ice really beats fire.
Show him.
[From.GetTitledName] has gone out onto the riverbank in the night and frozen the river from bank to bank, thick enough to carry a cannon. Your armies can cross where no bridge stands.
Across, before it thaws.

Where the daemons came through, the air is still torn. You can see it if you look sideways: a seam in the world, weeping light that is not light, with things moving behind it. The priests will not go near it. Someone has to close it.
Close it.
Leave it to the priests.

The Ice Queen's Ball is in full swing, and every face in the hall is behind a mask. The Sisterhood has always watched over the Ball, because the Ball has always drawn the crown's enemies like moths. Tonight it is your turn.
Watch the masks.
Dance. Nothing ever happens.

You take [frost_novice.GetFirstName] up onto the Frosthome glacier as the first snow falls, with a hide tent, a bag of dried fish and nothing else. For a whole winter she will live in the cold until it stops being her enemy. Many novices have made this climb. Not all of them came down.
Teach her the cold.

[frost_rival.GetTitledName] wants what is yours: the novice you found, or your seat at your lord's side, or both. She has said so in front of the court, coldly and politely, as the Sisterhood says everything. The court is waiting to see what you do.
Settle it with a duel of ice.
We are sisters. Let us be sisters.
Let her have it.

The hag [frost_hag.GetFirstName] sits by her fire with a pipe in her teeth and looks you up and down. The Sisterhood, she says, is a lot of girls playing in the snow. Her grandmother's grandmother knew magic before there was a Tzar or an Ice Palace, and she still does.
Walk away from the old woman.
Then teach me, grandmother.
Chaos is in the land. We stand together, or we fall separately.

An Ice Witch in white furs has come to your village for the girl. She has the gift, everyone knows it, and the Sisterhood will take her to Frosthome and make her one of them. The girl looks at you. So does the witch.
Go with her, child. It is a better life.
There is no girl here. Search all you like.
Take her, and take something of mine with her.

Deep in the woods, where the trees grow so close that no light reaches the snow, you find it: a hut of black logs, standing on two great scaly legs. It turns slowly to look at you. Smoke rises from the chimney. Somebody inside is singing.
Knock.
Call her by the old name.
Turn back while I still can.

The Hag-Mother is older than anything you have ever seen, and she is laughing. She sits you by her stove, feeds you soup you do not want to look at, and asks you three questions. The first is easy. The second is hard. The third, you understand, is the only one that matters.
Answer.

The Great Warding

Go to the Lynsk and pour your own life into the ice. For ten years your lord's lands in Kislev are warded against the north, and the Dark Gods lose ground. The cost is your health, for the rest of your life.
Hunt a Sorcerer
A Chaos sorcerer is hiding in the oblast. Find him, and see whether ice beats fire.
Freeze the River
Freeze the river in your lord's path so that his armies can cross where no bridge stands.
Seal the Breach
Where the daemons came through, the world is torn. Close the wound.
A Winter on the Glacier
Take a novice of your court onto the Frosthome glacier for a winter, and teach her the cold.
Seek the Hag-Mother
Go into the deep woods to find the walking hut of the Hag-Mother, the first of the hags. Some come back with gifts. Some do not come back.

Distaff of the Hag-Mother
